days.day_summary: Day 1 (2026-09-23, Chennai to Swaraj Dweep) has 20 events; the clock chain is continuous 03:45-24:00 with no gaps or overlaps, and the two big money items (Akasa QP 1145 at Rs 32,163 and Green Ocean 1 13:15-15:30 at Rs 4,200 all-in) are exactly supported by factbase. Six events are clean. 26 defects found: 3 critical (Green Ocean sent to Phoenix Bay when the only jetty fact in factbase says all four private catamarans sail from Haddo; the Neil's Cove walk requires being in two places at 17:10; an unsupported "Akasa bag-drop closes 06:55"), 11 major (two routes with wrong endpoints, Rs 350 + Rs 150 cab fares with no source, Bhuma's Rs 6,920 rate quoted for Sep 25-26 not Sep 23-24, petrol/parking arithmetic, and four unsupported hard claims: pump on Radhanagar road, 1.2 km to a cove whose position factbase marks UNKNOWN, "Blue-Flag beach, lifeguards on duty", "400 m from Bhuma"), and 12 minor. Post-fix the day's cost should rise by roughly Rs 500-1,000 (second scooter slot) plus the parking correction.

defects.problem: The event (and the ferry route ferry-pb-havelock, and the auto ride before it) puts the crew at Phoenix Bay Jetty for a Green Ocean sailing. The only jetty fact in factbase says the opposite: private catamarans sail from Haddo, and Phoenix Bay is the government-ferry jetty. Arriving at the wrong jetty at 11:55 for a 13:15 sailing with printed-ticket-only boarding would lose the crossing and the whole Havelock night.
defects.evidence: factbase research.ferries 'Port Blair jetty for private ferries': "Haddo Jetty per google search result snippets (BookYourFerry, Ferryhopper, FerryBooking.in: 'All four private catamaran operators depart from Haddo: Makruzz, Nautika, Green Ocean, ITT Majestic'). Phoenix Bay Jetty is the government-ferry jetty and a backup; not confirmed on an operator's own site."
defects.fix: Confirm the departure jetty on the Green Ocean ticket/portal before travel. If it is Haddo, add a 'haddo-jetty' place to P in populate_base.py (with its own cab route from Junglighat) and repoint events 8, 9, 10 and route ferry-pb-havelock to it; if Green Ocean's own ticket says Phoenix Bay, add that confirmation as a fact so the record stops contradicting the plan.

defects.problem: The block is 20 minutes long and route walk-radhanagar-cove is 1.2 km / 20 min one way, so the crew reaches the cove exactly at 17:10 with zero time there - and the very next event requires them to be back at Radhanagar Beach at 17:10 for sunset, 1.2 km (another 20 min) away. Impossible as written; in practice they miss the 17:15 sunset or skip the cove.
defects.evidence: populate_base.py R: ("walk-radhanagar-cove", "radhanagar", "neils-cove", "walk", 1.2, 20, ...); next event 'SUNSET @ Radhanagar Beach' starts 17:10 at place radhanagar. factbase weather_astro: 'Sunrise/sunset Sep 23 2026 :: Sunrise 05:09, Sunset 17:15 IST'.
defects.fix: Re-cut the Radhanagar block: ride 16:05-16:35, walk to Neil's Cove 16:35-16:55, cove 16:55-17:00, walk back 17:00-17:20 hmm - simplest safe version is arrive Radhanagar 16:20, walk out 16:20-16:40, cove 16:40-16:50, walk back 16:50-17:10, sunset 17:10-17:45. That means moving the Bhuma check-in and the Radhanagar ride ~30 min earlier (check-in 15:50-16:05, ride 16:05-16:20).

defects.problem: 'Akasa bag-drop closes 06:55' is a hard operational time with no support anywhere in factbase - the only Akasa facts are baggage allowances. If the real domestic cut-off is 60 min (06:40) rather than 45 min, the note is the kind of reassurance that gets a bag rejected. It also sits oddly beside the app's own MAA blurb, which says 'be at bag-drop by 06:10'.
defects.evidence: factbase research.flights contains only 'Akasa Air free baggage allowance (domestic) :: Check-in: 15 kg per customer, 1 piece only...' - no check-in/bag-drop cut-off fact exists. UNSUPPORTED.
defects.fix: Either add a verified fact from akasaair.com's check-in page to factbase and cite it, or soften the note to 'Akasa domestic counters close 45-60 min before departure - confirm on akasaair.com; we are at the desk by 05:15 either way.'

defects.problem: The event uses route cab-ixz-aberdeen (ixz -> aberdeen), but the crew's actual destination is Icy Spicy in Junglighat, which is 1.9 km from the airport in a different direction; Aberdeen Bazaar is a further 1.5 km north-east beyond it. The drawn line and the 2.7 km / 7 min stats describe a leg the crew never takes.
defects.evidence: populate_base.py R: ("cab-ixz-aberdeen", "ixz", "aberdeen", "cab", 2.7, 7, ...). Places: ixz 11.641656,92.730243; icy-spicy 11.6587633,92.7313498 (1.91 km apart); aberdeen 11.6675019,92.7412765. factbase food: 'Junglighat flagship (Island Arcade, opp. SBI, 3 min from airport)'.
defects.fix: Add a route ('cab-ixz-icyspicy', 'ixz', 'icy-spicy', 'cab', 2.2, 6, [[11.641656,92.730243],[11.650,92.730],[11.6587633,92.7313498]], 'VIP Rd / Junglighat, ~3 min from the airport per Icy Spicy\'s own site') and point this event at it.

defects.problem: cost_inr 350 for the airport cab has no cost_note and no backing price in factbase. The only Port Blair road-fare data point in the research is Chidiya Tapu (~25 km): cab Rs 1,500-3,500, auto Rs 800-1,200 - which implies a ~2 km hop is nothing like a verified Rs 350. The number is invented.

defects.fix: Add cost_note 'airport taxi to Junglighat, operator-range estimate - no published tariff verified' and either research the IXZ prepaid-taxi board into factbase or widen the line to Rs 300-500. Also confirm one vehicle takes 3 adults plus three 15 kg check-in bags.

defects.problem: The event uses route cab-ixz-phoenix, whose from_place is the airport - but the crew is at Icy Spicy, having already left the airport an hour earlier. This is not a reversed route, it is a different origin: the real leg is icy-spicy -> jetty, about 1.6 km, versus the route's 3.4 km / 8 min from IXZ.

Crew position at 11:40 is place icy-spicy (11.6587633,92.7313498); icy-spicy -> phoenix-bay is 1.59 km straight-line.

defects.problem: cost_inr 150 has no cost_note and no supporting price in factbase. Nothing in the research covers Port Blair auto fares for short hops, and an auto for 3 adults with three check-in bags is itself doubtful.
defects.evidence: No auto/taxi tariff fact for Port Blair short trips exists in factbase; the only comparable is Chidiya Tapu 'auto Rs.800-1,200' for ~25 km. UNSUPPORTED.
defects.fix: Add cost_note 'short auto hop, estimate - no verified tariff' and budget Rs 150-250, or book the same cab as the airport leg for the whole airport-lunch-jetty run and price it once.

defects.problem: Rs 6,920 is real, but factbase quotes it for the night of Sep 25-26 - the dates of the earlier Port-Blair-first plan. This itinerary sleeps at Bhuma on Sep 23-24, and no rate for that night was ever checked. Peak-arrival-day pricing and the '3 rooms left' note make it a genuinely stale number, not a rounding issue.

defects.problem: Two arithmetic errors in one line. (a) '~2 L petrol Rs 200 (@Rs 88.66/L)' - 2 L at Rs 88.66 is Rs 177.32, not Rs 200 (Rs 200 buys 2.26 L). (b) Parking Rs 30 covers one scooter, but the crew of 3 is on TWO scooters, so parking is Rs 40-60. Correct total is about Rs 237, not Rs 230, and the note misstates both components.

Beach No. 2 behind Havelock Power House'. UNSUPPORTED as 400 m.

defects.event_title: Scooters at the jetty -> ride out

Picking up at 15:30 on the 23rd burns slot 1, and Day 2 keeps the scooters until the ~13:00 jetty return - which falls in slot 2. Two scooters x two slots is Rs 2,000; Day 2 books only Rs 500 for the 'possible 2nd-slot charge', i.e. one scooter, so the trip is short Rs 500-1,000 and the Day 1 cost_note never mentions the slot rule at all.

days.day_summary: Day 2 (Thu 24 Sep 2026, Swaraj Dweep -> Shaheed Dweep), 29 events; the clock is perfectly contiguous 00:00-24:00 with no gaps or overlaps. The ferry leg is the strongest part of the day: Nautika-Pro 15:00->15:45 at 3 x Rs 1,600 Luxury matches the live-verified Leg A board for Thu 24 Sep to the rupee and the minute. Two critical breaks: (1) the Elephant Beach trek, which the day's theme is built on, is the subject of a REFUTED verification entry - "the trail closes in monsoon and the final stretch can be covered by tide" - while the event text still calls it merely "monsoon-muddy"; (2) the crew is scheduled to reach Laxmanpur at 17:15, one minute AFTER the verified 17:14 sunset, so the headline sunset event cannot happen as written. The Neil evening is also structurally wrong: three legs (16:05, 16:20, 19:00) use routes whose from_place is the jetty when the crew is at the Sitapur-side hotel or at Bharatpur/Lakshmanpur; the 16:05-16:20 "flash check-in" allots 15 minutes for a 10-minute ride plus a fuel stop plus a 3-person hotel check-in; and Blue Lagoon's Sitapur-side pin contradicts the factbase ("2 km from downtown/jetty near Laxmanpur side", distance explicitly NOT verified). Money: the Elephant Beach Rs 800 pp snorkel rate exists nowhere in the factbase, the scooter second-slot charge bills one scooter when the crew has two, and the Blue Lagoon Rs 3,968 is the rate researched for the night of Sep 26-27, not the Sep 24-25 night actually booked. 11 events are clean.

defects.event_title: NIGHT KAYAK - dark-window glow attempt + sunrise on the water
defects.problem: The block is 2 h 15 min, but the only verified operator description is a 1-2 hour trip. The payoff promised in the notes ('then sunrise 05:09 from the kayaks') requires the paddle to run at least 1 h 39 min past the 03:30 start, which the operator does not advertise. If Andaman Bliss runs its normal ~1.5 h trip the crew is off the water by ~05:00 and misses the sunrise the note sells.
defects.evidence: factbase research.activities: 'B: Bioluminescence kayaking operator price/timing (Andaman Bliss) :: Rs.3,500 pp all taxes; duration 1-2 hrs (~1.5 hr); Kayak Timing: Starts From 3:30 AM'. Cost 3 x Rs 3,500 = Rs 10,500 is correct; moonset 02:54, civil dawn 04:47 and sunrise 05:09 are all supported by weather_astro.
defects.fix: In the Wednesday-evening confirmation call, explicitly book the extended/sunrise-return slot and note 'operator standard is 1-2 h; sunrise return confirmed by phone'. If they will not extend, shorten the block to 03:30-05:10 and take the sunrise at Kala Pathar instead (arrive 04:45).

defects.problem: Route 'ride-govind-kalapathar' has from_place=govind-nagar, but at 05:45 the crew is at kayak-point (the Beach No.5 night-launch spot), not Govind Nagar. The drawn line starts at the wrong end.
defects.evidence: populate_base.py R: ('ride-govind-kalapathar', 'govind-nagar', 'kalapathar', 'scooter', 3.7, 8, ...). Preceding event place = 'kayak-point' (12.026, 93.003), described as the 'Andaman Bliss night-kayak meet point (Beach No.5 area)'.
defects.fix: Add a kayak-point -> kalapathar route (~4.5 km, ~10 min via SH5), or insert a short kayak-point -> govind-nagar hop before this leg.

defects.problem: Notes assert 'Golden hour is 05:45-06:45'. UNSUPPORTED - the factbase carries no golden-hour data at all, and the window is inconsistent with the sunrise it would derive from: with sunrise at 05:09 the soft-light hour runs roughly 05:09-06:10, so the 06:10 arrival lands at the END of golden hour, not the start.
defects.evidence: Only relevant fact is weather_astro 'Sunrise/sunset Sep 24-27 2026 :: Sep 24: 05:09/17:14 ... Civil dawn ~04:47-04:48'. No 'golden hour' string exists anywhere in data/factbase.json.
defects.fix: Delete the invented window; replace with 'Sunrise was 05:09 - light is already high by 06:10; shoot the black rocks backlit rather than expecting golden hour.'

days.day_summary: Day 3 (2026-09-25, Neil → Port Blair) has a contiguous, gap-free 00:00–24:00 timeline and its two anchor facts are solid: sunrise 05:09 and sunset 17:14 (factbase weather_astro "Sep 25: 05:09/17:14") and the 08:51 / 0.40 m low tide for the Natural Bridge (factbase "Tides Sep 25 2026: ... Low 08:51 (0.40 m)"). The Makruzz 11:30→12:30 Neil→PB sailing and its ₹6,525 (3 × [1,850 + 325]) are exactly right per factbase ferry_gapfill Leg B. The problems cluster in four places: (1) every Neil scooter leg is attached to a route that starts at Shaheed Dweep Jetty even though the crew is based at Blue Lagoon on the Sitapur side — three wrong-origin routes with mismatched durations; (2) the Munda Pahad block contradicts the only Munda Pahad source in the factbase (1.5 km / 45–60 min each way, not "1.3 km, ~30 min"), leaving a 105-min slot with zero summit time; (3) money: the Port Blair scooters are priced at a rate Eternal Andamans does not publish and are never returned anywhere in Days 3–5, the Hotel Atlanta ₹8,845 is a live quote for Sep 23–25 while the stay is Sep 25–27, and the Chidiya Tapu fuel arithmetic does not reconcile; (4) unsupported text: an invented ₹500 Natural Bridge guide fee, "200 m from the hotel" for Annapurna (really ~660 m), a crocodile warning with zero factbase support, a "65-min margin" that contradicts the trek event's own "50-min margin", and the pink sand / cave / shipwreck claims at Sitapur. Six events are clean.

days.day_summary: Day 4 (Sat 2026-09-26, Baratang) has a clean skeleton — 18 events, zero clock gaps or overlaps (00:00→24:00 contiguous, and it joins Day 3's 24:00 sleep and Day 5's 00:00 sleep correctly), all four route ids resolve, all places are on the right island, and the ferry-only island change to Baratang and back is modelled properly. The defects are in three clusters. (1) COST: the Rs 7,500 cab figure and its "verified range Rs 6,500–9,000" match no price in factbase (verified figures are Rs 4,500 cab-only round trip, Rs 6,300/7,300 two-pax packages, Rs 8,400 Go2Andaman private for up to 2 pax), and calling it a "day-tour" double-counts the Rs 2,700 speedboat, which every verified package price already includes; the Rs 450 Baratang lunch is invented outright (factbase has zero Baratang food data). (3) TIMING: the return convoy block (12:10–13:40) is 13 min shorter than a 12:30 departure over the 83-min convoy route allows; the Cellular Jail block ignores the verified show schedule (17:45 arrival for a 17:50 show, 90-min block for a ~45-min show, and no English show exists on a Saturday); walk-atlanta-marina is 1.4 km in 3 min on foot (28 km/h — impossible, and it contradicts the event's own "5 min"); and the day has NO food at all from Day 3's 19:00 dinner to the 11:00 lunch, ~16 hours, despite factbase saying nothing opens before 07:00 and to carry food from the previous evening.
